what: Hold the mouse down for 170ms and a circle of radius 150px opens at the cursor, growing by .16 each frame (on release it closes at the same rate). Inside the circle a background-colored circle is overlaid with difference, turning it into an inverted blueprint — a 16px grid (.22), an accent crosshair (.55) · center dot, a 72-notch ring (8px every 6 notches), x · y coordinates at the bottom, and the visible elements inside the circle (data-fx-part=note) box · label (name W×H) · font size · memo. The circle follows the cursor at .6 while held and .3 normally. When not pressed it is an 11px accent-color ring cursor (1.7× while pressed)
ease: Follow each frame ratio (.16 open · .6/.3 positions)

options.hold: Hold time needed to open (ms), default 170
options.open · follow · idle: Open share · follow while held · follow normally, defaults .16 · .6 · .3
options.cursor: If off, does not draw the ring cursor
options.[data-fx-part=note]: Element to annotate inside the circle — data-x (name) · data-note (memo)

use: Your title here
note: Not applied on touch devices (hover false). The original opens on a 380ms finger press, but that must block page dragging in the meantime, which clashes with the promise not to block phones. Pressing on a link, button or input does not open it
